title: deploymentState
responsibility: Reads validated deployment receipts shared across this repository and its worktrees.

inputs.name: deploymentState.root
inputs.description: Directory inside a Git repository or one of its worktrees, passed to git -C to locate the shared common Git directory that holds the harness-deployments/receipts.json file. Every worktree of a repository resolves to the same receipts, and a directory outside any repository makes git fail, so the operation rejects.

inputs.name: saveDeployment.root
inputs.description: Directory inside a Git repository or one of its worktrees, passed to git -C to locate the shared receipts directory before the stored receipts are read and replaced. A directory outside any repository makes git fail, so the save rejects and nothing is written.

inputs.name: saveDeployment.receipt
inputs.description: Receipt for one environment (dev, stage, preprod or prod) that replaces any stored receipt with the same environment and is appended after the others. It is written without schema validation, so an invalid receipt makes later reads of receipts.json reject with ZodError.

inputs.name: deploymentStatus.root
inputs.description: Directory inside a Git repository or one of its worktrees, passed to git -C to locate the shared receipts and also passed unchanged to plugin.discover. A directory outside any repository makes git fail, so the call rejects before discover is called.

inputs.name: deploymentStatus.plugin
inputs.description: Deployment adapter whose discover(root) supplies the configured target for each environment. Only discover is called, and if it rejects the error is caught, so every status is reported as unavailable with the reason 'Cloudflare configuration is unavailable or invalid.'

outputs.name: deploymentState
outputs.description: Receipts read from the shared receipts.json, parsed and validated against the receipt schema, in stored order. It resolves to an empty list when that file does not exist, and also when the git executable is missing, because that ENOENT is caught as well.

outputs.name: saveDeployment
outputs.description: Resolves with undefined once the updated receipt list has been written to a temporary file in the receipts directory and renamed over receipts.json. Saves to that directory are queued in this process so they run one at a time, and read, validation or write errors reject the promise.

outputs.name: deploymentStatus
outputs.description: One entry per environment, in the order dev, stage, preprod and prod, with its stored receipt or null and available set to whether discover reports a target for that environment. The reason is 'Cloudflare target configured.' or 'Deployment target not configured.' for each entry, or 'Cloudflare configuration is unavailable or invalid.' for every entry when discover rejects.

examples.reason: Cloudflare configuration is unavailable or invalid.
Cloudflare configuration is unavailable or invalid.
Cloudflare configuration is unavailable or invalid.
Cloudflare configuration is unavailable or invalid.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse when receipts.json exists but is not valid JSON; each operation rejects with it.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown by receipts.parse when receipts.json is valid JSON but its contents are not an array of valid receipts; each operation rejects with it.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the git error when git rev-parse --git-common-dir fails, such as outside a repository, or with a file-system error from reading, creating, writing or renaming receipt files; a missing receipts.json reads as an empty list instead.
